_comment: DESIGN.md v3.2 §F. Every decision number used by code lives here; code reads it via biomark.paths.load_config('design_params'). Frozen at tag freeze-design; keys marked provisional (negative_controls_s7 NC2-NC6) are replaced from the toy run and frozen at tag freeze-bounds (DESIGN §13.4). Later changes need a D-entry.

data_s1.deadline: first dictionary build: build_dictionary.py reads results/data_status.json (committed first) and stores its sha256 in dictionary_v1.json; later files feed labelled secondaries only
data_s1.msi_cmp_role: Cell Model Passports msi_status: concordance check only

eligibility_s2.non_eligible_controls: U_ctrl: analysed separately; excluded from every top-k list, the null subset and P1/P2

dependency_s2.accurate_dependent_rule: observed dependent AND fold-centred prediction rank (most negative first) <= n_g, n_g = number of dependent D lines of g
dependency_s2.R_accurate_dependent_rule: R refit prediction <= quantile(R predictions, n_g/n_D) (target-free, computed before freeze-catalogue)

dictionary_s3.lof_bi_rule: damaging dosage 2 OR (dosage >= 1 AND (own CN < cn_loss OR SIL OR LikelyLoF call with AF >= lof_bi_af_min)) OR (X-linked AND male AND dosage >= 1)

fusion.driver_list: configs/fusion_drivers.csv (built from CIViC/MOAlmanac fusion profiles and OncoKB fusion genes)
fusion.orientation: driver from fusion_drivers.csv is the 3-prime gene (5-prime for FGFR2/3)

dictionary_s3.hypermutated_rule: MSI OR TMB in top hypermutated_top_frac of D
dictionary_s3.clin_source: configs/cgt_features.csv (scripts/build_cgt_features.py, molecular data only; built before the first dictionary build)
dictionary_s3.partner_priors: partner genes in configs/positive_controls_spec.csv (feature genes other than the dependency)
dictionary_s3.tmb_definition: log1p(number of default-entry protein-altering calls in OmicsSomaticMutations)

methylation._comment: PI amendment D7 (v3.1): RRBS registered before the first dictionary build.
methylation.source: external/depmap_extra/CCLE_RRBS_TSS1kb_20181022.txt.gz (CCLE names -> ModelID via Model.csv CCLEName; unmapped columns dropped and counted)
methylation.gene_value: max over the gene's TSS±1kb loci (locus_id prefix = HGNC symbol) of the methylation fraction
methylation.METH_rule: gene_value >= meth_high AND gene_value - D lineage median >= 0.3; restricted_gene_set genes only; >= min_carriers among RRBS-profiled D lines; NA for lines without RRBS
methylation.universe: U_G (stage G); access class proxy (not a predictor input)
methylation.lineage_proxy_rule: same Cramer's V rule as SIL
methylation.self_null: METH_g and SIL-METH_g are self-null (removed from 𝒟_g, kept as NC3 checks)
methylation.not_assayed: lines without RRBS: METH NA, METH_absent indicator; coverage reported

spectra.SIG:SPEC_POLE: 1 if SNV count >= D 99th percentile AND indel/SNV ratio < 0.05
spectra.SIG:SPEC_TOBACCO: C>A fraction among SNVs, SPEC_POLE lines excluded (NA)
spectra.SIG:SPEC_UV: fraction of CC>TT dinucleotide substitutions among all substitutions
spectra.input: coding (protein-altering) calls only; lines with < min_snvs SNVs are NA

dictionary_s3.variant_groups: locus groups (AMP/DEL/LOSS), allele groups (HOT:x with ALLELE:x_* and CLIN features built from them) and SIL groups (mutually exclusive SIL mechanisms of one gene)

surrogate_s4.stage_X_target: the fit's own stage-G residual (each CV fold, subsample and full fit)
surrogate_s4.subsample_design: complementary halves, patient-grouped, lineage-stratified; seed seeds.json:subsample_seed
rank_rule_EN: abs(mean beta over all 50 subsamples, zeros included) desc
surrogate_s4.subsample_file: configs/subsamples.json (drawn once from seeds.json:subsample_seed; shared by all genes and arms; fit rows = subsample ∩ non-NaN)
surrogate_s4.fwl_cache: residualised 𝒟 per (NaN-pattern group × fold or subsample), memmapped read-only
surrogate_s4.dedup_before_topk: best-ranked member per (g, variant group), all arms

attribution_s4.scope: M1-proxy exact linear attribution only (no M3 refit)

drop_rules: only droppable covariates may be dropped
covariate is d or in d's variant group
association with d > drop_assoc_r2_gt (R^2 of d on the covariate's dummies; numeric: r^2)
own CN omitted when d is CN-derived and its group contains g (own-CN-adjusted = sensitivity)
TP53 omitted when d derives from TP53 or MDM2 amplification
confounders_s5.se_type: CR2 (PatientID clusters; HC2 for singletons) for all tests; CR1 logged sensitivity only
confounders_s5.media_column_rule: parse base medium from the column whose values match the formulation regex in >= 90% of non-empty cells (Model.csv OnboardedMedia/FormulationID appear swapped); screened condition first (ModelCondition), else Model.csv, else unknown
confounders_s5.collinear_with_design_rule: R^2(d ~ lineage + library + culture + growth) > 0.49: keep design, label collinear_with_design, never a determinant (class 6 or lineage-unresolvable)
confounders_s5.df_rule: t with df = min(n - rank(Z) - 2, nu), nu = max(1, (sum_c W_c)^2 / sum_c W_c^2 - 1), W_c = sum over lines i of cluster c of dtilde_i^2
confounders_s5.df_fallback_if_calibration_fails: binary d: df = number of carrier clusters - 1
confounders_s5.cr2_implementation: singletons: h_ii = h_Z,ii + dtilde_i^2/sum(dtilde^2); multi-line clusters (2-4 lines): batched closed-form (I - H_cc)^-1/2 with rank-1 update; computed per (NaN group, d) and reused across genes

s1_s5.test: OLS partial t on FWL residuals with CR2 SE and nu df (confounders_s5.df_rule); F = t^2

md_strict_s5.d_stage_test: confounder model on observed D effects, CR2 + nu
md_strict_s5.pass: same sign as selection AND BH q_sc < 0.05 within EN-pred selected candidates
md_strict_s5.label: selection_conditional (nominal); error rate reported = empirical FDR (§7)

test_families_s5.F1_S1_main: all (g,d) in U with d not EXPDOSE own; BH at count run
test_families_s5.F2_S1_EXP_own: own EXPDOSE tests; separate BH; excluded from P1 pools and from recall of non-expression biomarkers
test_families_s5.F3_EN_D_stage: EN-pred (and EN-obs) selected candidates; BH q_sc; screening only
test_families_s5.F4_cross_lineage_meta: pooled confounder-model tests restricted to testable lineages, all (g,d) entering §8.3
test_families_s5.F7_cgt_ceiling: S/W CGT tests with >= 3 carriers; BH q < 0.1

replication_s6.shrinkage: empirical-Bayes normal scale mixture (20 log-spaced sigma, EM <= 500 iter) on standardised effects beta* = beta*SD_D(dtilde) of all U rows incl. F2; posterior mean back-transformed; identical for all arms
replication_s6.power_formula: 1 - F_t(t_0.95,nu_R; ncp = |beta_shrunk| / SE_R_pred), nu_R from confounders_s5.df_rule on R carriers
replication_s6.R_nan_pattern: gene expected non-NaN for an R line if >= R_nan_frac_min of D lines with the same library string are non-NaN; unseen strings use the union NaN set of their component libraries
replication_s6.xlib_discovery: D lines whose library string is exactly 'Avana'
replication_s6.xlib_replication: D lines with no Avana in the library string

R_evaluable.binary: >= 3 carriers and >= 3 non-carriers with expected non-NaN effect

bootstrap_rules: lists, covariate drops and pool fixed from the full-R fit
resampled patient copies get new cluster ids
zero-variance columns dropped by pivoted QR and logged
pair with < 2 distinct carrier or < 2 distinct non-carrier patients in a draw = not replicated

null_s7.unit: one within-stratum permutation of line labels applied jointly to all 𝒟 rows (shared, gene-specific, and NA indicators/masks CN_absent, MSI_unknown); targets, predictions and covariates (incl. own CN, EXPGATE) fixed
null_s7.strata: lineage x library_group; strata < 2 lines merged into the lineage's largest stratum
null_s7.raise_rule: B = 50 iff 50 x wall(permutation 1) <= wall_cap_min, decided from timing only, before any observed-run output is read
null_s7.primary: fixed-threshold null: observed per-gene per-stage lambda_1SE, SIS K, freq/sign rules, observed F1 BH p-cutoff p*_F1 (full observed family), observed S1-pred cutoff, observed MD-strict cutoff p*_sc with same-sign rule
null_s7.secondary: selection-adaptive re-run incl. lambda CV and BH (FDR_emp_rerun); reported only

negative_controls_s7._comment: NC1 is a pre-declared target and is never replaced. NC2-NC6 values are provisional; at freeze-bounds they are replaced per toy_s13.nc_bound_rule (5 replicates, max; min for NC6) and status_NC2_NC6 becomes 'frozen'; provisional and toy-derived values are both recorded in frozen_hashes.json:bounds.

cross_lineage.meta: descriptive: Paule-Mandel tau2 with HKSJ CI (statsmodels combine_effects, method_re='iterated'), I2, tau, prediction interval
cross_lineage.lolo: sign kept when each contributing lineage is dropped
cross_lineage.restricted: >= 2 testable lineages AND per-lineage BH q < 0.05 (F5) AND d x lineage interaction p < 0.05
cross_lineage.pooled_significance: confounder model restricted to testable lineages (lineage fixed effects, CR2 + nu); BH over F4
cross_lineage.powered_lineage: per-lineage power >= powered_lineage_power_min at one-sided alpha 0.05 under replication_s6.power_formula
cross_lineage.unresolvable: < 2 powered lineages ('single-lineage carriers' when one lineage has carriers)

subtypes_s8.line_share_def: s = beta_gd*(xtilde_ld - xbar_d) / sum over selected d' (both stages, FWL-residualised features, full-D EN-pred fit) of beta_gd'*(xtilde_ld' - xbar_d'); only lines with negative sum; binary d also needs carrier status
subtypes_s8.culture_flag_rescue: within-stratum test keeps sign at p < 0.05

gate_s9.recovered: (g, primary or secondary feature) in the list with the expected sign
gate_s9.gate_eligible: dependency gene has >= 100 non-NaN D lines AND feature in 𝒟 with >= min_carriers (binary) or available (continuous)
report_strata: PAR rows with a non-direct encoding
gate_s9.sil_expansion: a spec id SIL:<x> expands in build_positive_controls.py to every SIL-DEL/SIL-MUT/SIL-METH/SIL-other:<x> feature in 𝒟; recovered if any expanded feature is recovered with the expected sign

clinical_s10.family_rule: recovered if any member hit; ceiling uses Bonferroni x |T| within the test
tiers: T1 regulatory approval with label biomarker
T2 CIViC A/B Supports or NCCN-cited, not approved
clinical_s10.proxy_rule: allele tests use ALLELE features (proxy=0); a labelled secondary copy with HOT:<gene>, proxy=1, only where the gene-level call approximates the allele; never in the headline
clinical_s10.testable_rule: feature_D in U with >= testable_min_carriers carriers
miss_decomposition: no feature_D or feature not in 𝒟_g
clinical_s10.fusion_known_positives_file: configs/fusion_known_positives.csv (cell-line names resolved to ModelID via Model.csv)
clinical_s10.brca_biallelic: dosage 2, or damaging with AF >= 0.7 or own CN < 0.75, or SIL BRCA1; hypermutated lines excluded

excluded: parrish2021 (counts only; processed GI tables blocked)
combinatorial_s11.gold_standard: hit in >= 2 screens or >= 2 cell lines
combinatorial_s11.background: screened pairs matched on sequence-identity decile and family size

compute_s14.determinism: shared configs/subsamples.json; coordinate descent deterministic; no per-gene seeds

toy_s13.predictor: ridge trained by 5-fold CV on noisy toy observations, plus per-fold offsets
toy_s13.writes_nc_bounds: results/toy/nc_bounds.json: NC2-NC6 per replicate and the max (min for NC6) over replicates
toy_s13.authorship: different agent; commits carry an 'Agent: <name>' trailer
toy_s13.nc_bound_rule: max over replicates (min for NC6) at toy dimensions; if the 5 replicates exceed the toy_run_bounds timebox, the provisional values become final (deviations.csv)

gene_level_classes: 3 r_within < 0.10 or fidelity < 0.10 or M1 named share < 0.5
3b predictable and nameable, no MD-strict determinant
limits_s12.aggregation: 9 if any pair is class 9, else max pair class; all pair classes listed

cards.not_in_curated_lists: not in positive_controls ∪ CGT ∪ P1 biomarker_pairs ∪ oncogene_pairs
cards.setA_flag: fraction of set A lines dependent on g

indep_s13.en_selected_set: identical excluding features within en_freq_tol of selection_freq_min
